GENERAL SCIENCE — TERMLY EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GENERAL SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

9. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)

   B. Only carbon dioxide

   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Removing all vegetation

12. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 50 °C

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Plant growth and development ● Concept of growth and development in plants ● See? (1 mark)

   A. watt (W)
   B. joule (J)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. newton (N)

16. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water always increases oxygen
